<?php
// جسر واتساب لنظام صافي: البرنامج على السيرفر يدز الرسائل الجديدة هنا، والكاشير يقراها
header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
$dir = __DIR__ . '/data';
if (!is_dir($dir)) { @mkdir($dir, 0700, true); }
if (!file_exists($dir . '/.htaccess')) { @file_put_contents($dir . '/.htaccess', "Require all denied\nDeny from all\n"); }
function out($a, $code = 200) { http_response_code($code); echo json_encode($a, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE); exit; }
function rj($f, $d) { if (!file_exists($f)) return $d; $j = json_decode(file_get_contents($f), true); return is_array($j) ? $j : $d; }
function wj($f, $a) { file_put_contents($f, json_encode($a, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), LOCK_EX); }
function chk($hdr, $kf) {
  $k = isset($_SERVER[$hdr]) ? (string)$_SERVER[$hdr] : '';
  if (strlen($k) < 16) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'nokey'], 401);
  if (!file_exists($kf)) { file_put_contents($kf, password_hash($k, PASSWORD_DEFAULT)); @chmod($kf, 0600); }
  if (!password_verify($k, trim(file_get_contents($kf)))) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'badkey'], 403);
}
$mf = $dir . '/wa_msgs.json'; $sf = $dir . '/wa_state.json'; $cf = $dir . '/wa_cmd.json';
$a = isset($_GET['a']) ? $_GET['a'] : '';

// ===== من البرنامج (مفتاح البرنامج) =====
if ($a === 'push' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
  chk('HTTP_X_WA_KEY', $dir . '/.wakey');
  $j = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
  if (!is_array($j)) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'json'], 400);
  $st = rj($sf, []);
  $st['beat'] = time();
  if (isset($j['status'])) $st['status'] = substr((string)$j['status'], 0, 20);
  if (array_key_exists('qr', $j)) { $st['qr'] = $j['qr'] ? substr((string)$j['qr'], 0, 1000) : ''; $st['qrTs'] = time(); }
  if (isset($j['me'])) $st['me'] = substr((string)$j['me'], 0, 40);
  wj($sf, $st);
  if (!empty($j['msgs']) && is_array($j['msgs'])) {
    $m = rj($mf, []); $ids = array_flip(array_column($m, 'id'));
    foreach ($j['msgs'] as $x) {
      $id = substr((string)($x['id'] ?? ''), 0, 80);
      if ($id === '' || isset($ids[$id])) continue;
      $m[] = ['id' => $id, 'from' => substr((string)($x['from'] ?? ''), 0, 30), 'name' => mb_substr((string)($x['name'] ?? ''), 0, 60),
        'text' => mb_substr((string)($x['text'] ?? ''), 0, 600), 'ts' => (int)($x['ts'] ?? time()), 'at' => (int)round(microtime(true) * 1000)];
      $ids[$id] = 1;
    }
    if (count($m) > 300) $m = array_slice($m, -300);
    wj($mf, $m);
  }
  $c = rj($cf, []); if ($c) @unlink($cf);
  out(['ok' => true, 'cmd' => $c ? ($c['cmd'] ?? '') : '']);
}

// حفظ ربط الواتساب هنا، حتى السيرفر المجاني إذا انمسح ما يحتاج مسح كود من جديد
if ($a === 'auth') {
  chk('HTTP_X_WA_KEY', $dir . '/.wakey');
  $af = $dir . '/wa_auth.json';
  if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $b = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if (strlen($b) > 8 * 1024 * 1024) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'size'], 400);
    if ($b === '' || $b === '{}') { @unlink($af); out(['ok' => true, 'cleared' => true]); }
    if (!is_array(json_decode($b, true))) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'json'], 400);
    file_put_contents($af, $b, LOCK_EX); @chmod($af, 0600);
    out(['ok' => true]);
  }
  if (!file_exists($af)) out(['ok' => true, 'files' => new stdClass()]);
  echo '{"ok":true,"files":' . file_get_contents($af) . '}'; exit;
}

// ===== من الكاشير (نفس مفتاح النسخ الاحتياطي) =====
$key = isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_SAFI_KEY']) ? (string)$_SERVER['HTTP_X_SAFI_KEY'] : '';
if (strlen($key) < 4) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'nokey'], 401);
$kf = $dir . '/.key';
if (!file_exists($kf)) { file_put_contents($kf, password_hash($key, PASSWORD_DEFAULT)); @chmod($kf, 0600); }
if (!password_verify($key, trim(file_get_contents($kf)))) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'badkey'], 403);
if ($a === 'poll') {
  $since = isset($_GET['since']) ? (int)$_GET['since'] : 0;
  $m = rj($mf, []); $r = [];
  foreach ($m as $x) if ($x['at'] > $since) $r[] = $x;
  $st = rj($sf, []);
  $st['age'] = isset($st['beat']) ? time() - $st['beat'] : -1;
  if (!empty($st['qrTs']) && time() - $st['qrTs'] > 70) $st['qr'] = '';
  out(['ok' => true, 'state' => $st, 'msgs' => array_slice($r, -50), 'now' => (int)round(microtime(true) * 1000)]);
}
if ($a === 'cmd' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
  $j = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
  $cmd = is_array($j) ? (string)($j['cmd'] ?? '') : '';
  if (!in_array($cmd, ['relink'], true)) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'cmd'], 400);
  wj($cf, ['cmd' => $cmd, 'ts' => time()]);
  out(['ok' => true]);
}
out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'bad'], 400);
